name: Poulan PL1416
blurb: Oregon's fit guide, one row under PL1416: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links (Oregon S56).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints PL1416 on its own line with one chain under it: S56, 16″, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

bars.note: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints S56 directly under PL1416: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size or a Poulan part number for this row.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide, Poulan / Poulan Pro section: one chain row printed directly under the model

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), Poulan / Poulan Pro section, read 5 Nov 2026. Only models with a single chain row printed directly under the model name are listed. Models that share a block of several chain lengths are not given a page here.
